title: Doxbro's Things Mod
description: A cheaply made mod I made with Mcreator.
body:
_(This is my first ever mod)_

This mod adds new ores, blocks, mobs, and 1 new dimension.
This mod was made with MCreator so expect it to be bad.

### Features!

**This is The Boi. One of the new mobs that are in the mod. Don't try hurting him.**
![the boi lol](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a4e4c3b53eb17b6c9911ef5744f0436fce3d2d00.png)

**A small showcase of some of the new ores and blocks.**
![awesome blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/852835386caafce298a3e6fad81fca0005c7e014.png)

**Screenshot of the new dimension. It's called "Awesome World". You can get to it my making a portal out of crying obsidian. And using the "Awesome Flame" onto the portal.**
![awesome world](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fe4b7a036ff6efe347297b1d53fc626c84d5bb53_0.webp)
